dct_description_sm: Bilston Creek Watershed water quality monitoring program aims to strengthen community partnerships and implement protocols for sustainable, community-based stewardship of watershed ecology and Coastal Cutthroat Trout habitat. Bilston Creek Watershed covers 3129 ha in Sc’ianew territory, Langford and Metchosin, Capital Regional District, BC. Water quality data is collected monthly from locations on Bilston Creek and six tributary streams to identify water quality status and trends across the watershed.
dct_title_s: Bilston Watershed Habitat Protection Association Water Quality Monitoring
